question: According to Economic Survey 2025-2026, India’s expected real GDP growth for FY27 is:
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Option 3**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Economic Survey 2025–26** gives the **real GDP growth projection** for the coming year.

 
 
• 
 
For **FY27**, the Survey estimates growth in the band of **6.8%–7.2%**.

 
 
• 
 
This is based on:

 
 
• 
 
**strong macro fundamentals**

 
 
• 
 
**capex-led growth**

 
 
• 
 
**stable fiscal consolidation**

 
 
• 
 
improving **investment cycle**

 
 
• 
 
supportive reforms in taxation, labour, digitalisation etc.
